protocol.order: AR/eager/graph on even pairs; graph/eager/AR on odd pairs
protocol.baseline: Immediate parent eager verifier via graph_mode=off; all other production methods unchanged
protocol.candidate: Default public verifier graph auto; shared bounded graph-stage ownership
protocol.surface: LLM.stream_detailed for AR; LLM.stream_speculative_mtp_detailed for MTP
protocol.decode_timing: Observed first-token to last-token wall; denominator is generated tokens minus first observed cumulative count. Terminal duplicate chunks excluded.
protocol.first_token_timing: Public call start to first token, including prefill and MTP prompt priming.
protocol.whole_call_timing: Public call start through iterator exhaustion; model construction and snapshot extraction excluded after warmup.
protocol.profile: Shipping backend defaults; no gfx1151 PARO execution-profile plan resolves. No arithmetic or variant override.
protocol.cross_route_id_equality: Diagnostic, not a same-schedule repeatability check.
